title: The observed-run lint takes any dotted number for a version and flags 'in the long run'
goal: kb-verify's unversioned_run warns on an observed-run DER fact whose only number is a measurement (2.5 s, TLS 1.2) and not on ordinary phrases such as 'in the long run' or 'in a pipeline run'. Found by the SP-2agxqrrv review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.claude/skills/kb-verify'); import lint; sys.exit(0 if lint.unversioned_run('- Observed on PL-LT-00123: the wait took 2.5 s. [DER S1]', {'DER'}) and not lint.unversioned_run('- In the long run the cache wins. [DER S1]', {'DER'}) else 1)
